3 amazing machines, explained in under a minute!
This crate is heavy. Lifting it straight up takes a lot of force.
But loop the rope around a few wheels, and now four ropes share the weight.
You pull four times farther, but with just a quarter of the force!
Push down on the small piston.
The liquid can't be squeezed, so the pressure spreads everywhere.
The big piston has a much bigger area, so it pushes up much harder. Enough to lift a car!
Electricity flows through a loop of wire, turning it into a magnet.
The magnets push one side up, and the other side down, so the loop spins.
Every half turn, the current flips, so it keeps on spinning.
Simple science, huge power! Which machine should we explain next?
